sloka: अनुज्ञातः सुमन्त्रः अथ योजयित्वा हय उत्तमान् ।अयोध्याम् एव नगरीम् प्रययौ गाढ दुर्मनाः ॥२-५७-३॥
transliteration: anujñātaḥ sumantraḥ atha yojayitvā haya uttamān ।ayodhyām eva nagarīm prayayau gāḍha durmanāḥ ॥2-57-3॥

translations.english: Permitted by Rama to leave, Sumantra harnessed the best of horses and set out for the city of Ayodhya with a heavy heart.
